title: Counting the Cancellation Run-Off by Cancellation Reason: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) SR-26 Schedule
content:
On a cancellation SR-26 under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44), the counting of the run-off follows why and when the backing term ended. This applies to the SR-26 sent for a certificate whose backing term, an Owner Auto Policy term or a Named Non-Owner Policy term, was cancelled and has not been reinstated. It is read from the term's cancellation reason and its closed date (the cancellation effective date).

## Decision table

| Cancellation reason and timing | Cancellation run-off days |
|---|---|
| insured request | counted from the term's closed date: the certificate's run-off days less the calendar days from the closed date to the SR-26 date (zero days when the closed date is later than the SR-26 date), never below zero |
| nonpayment, with no more than the package's reinstatement window days, in calendar days, from the closed date to the SR-26 date | the larger of the certificate's run-off days and the reinstatement window days less those calendar days |
| any other case | the certificate's run-off days, counted from the SR-26 date |

**The reinstatement window.** This is the number of reinstatement window days that the backing term's package carries in the Owner Auto Policy or Named Non-Owner Policy schedule. The nonpayment row applies while the days from the closed date to the SR-26 date are equal to that window or fewer. One day more falls under the last row.

**Day counts.** "The calendar days from the closed date to the SR-26 date" is the number of days by which the SR-26 date falls after the closed date.

## Worked figures

The figures use a hypothetical certificate run-off of 19 days and a hypothetical package window of 40 days. Neither is a schedule value.

| Reason | Closed date | SR-26 date | Run-off |
|---|---|---|---|
| insured request | day 0 | day 5 | 19 less 5, which is 14 |
| insured request | day 0 | day 25 | below zero, so 0 |
| nonpayment | day 0 | day 6 | the larger of 19 and 40 less 6 (34), which is 34 |
| nonpayment | day 0 | day 40 | the larger of 19 and 0, which is 19 |
| nonpayment | day 0 | day 41 | outside the window: 19 |
| underwriting | day 0 | day 3 | 19 |
